The '''LCK 2018 Summer''' was the second split of the 2018 [[League of Legends Champions Korea]] season, organized by Riot Games with broadcasts handled by OGN and SPOTV GAMES. The league took place from June 12 to September 8, 2018, in Seoul, South Korea, with all matches hosted offline at LoL Park. The Regular Season was played as a Double Round Robin with Best-of-Three matches, followed by a Single Elimination King of the Hill Playoffs in Best-of-Five format. Ten teams competed for a ₩275,000,000 KRW prize pool and qualification toward the [[World Championship/2018|2018 World Championship]]. [[MVP]] and [[Griffin]] qualified through the [[LCK/2018/Summer/Promotion|Summer Promotion Tournament]]. During the offseason, [[KSV eSports]] rebranded to [[Gen.G]], while [[Hanwha Life Esports]] acquired the roster and league spot of [[ROX Tigers]]. Matches were played from Patch 8.11 through Patch 8.15.

==Format==
*'''Group Stage'''
** Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo3}}
*** {{bgcolortext|byeup|''1st place''}} advance to the Finals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''2nd place''}} advance to the Semifinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''3rd place''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stayup|''4th and 6th place''}} advance to the Wild Card Round of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''6th till 8th place''}} qualify for [[LCK/2019/Spring|Spring split]].
*** {{bgcolortext|down|''9th and 10th place''}} will have to play in the [[LCK/2019/Spring/Promotion|Spring Promotion Tournament]].
** Tiebreaker order:
**# Match score
**# Game difference (game wins - game loss)
**# Head-to-head
*'''Playoffs'''
**Top 5 from Group Stage
** Single Elimination King of the Hill.
*** Wild Card match is {{Abbr/Bo3}}.
*** Round 1 onwards is {{Abbr/Bo5}}.
** Winner qualifies for [[World Championship/2018|Worlds 2018]]
